title: The People Not Here
label: ch:ta-avarkal
canDo: I can talk about somebody who is not in the room, choosing between the familiar and respectful words, and I can say we in the two ways Tamil requires.

payoff.summary: From cold: the four third-person and we-words, the front letter that marks distance, and the question each choice answers.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. avar itself moved to chapter 37, beside the lesson whose own table had been showing the a- column without ever naming a word for it.
